title: Bins of +5 and +3 still show quantity 8 and $80 in Inventory Value
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919); the Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' and 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' and can see costs and prices.
  • Bin {Bin-A} is the default bin of {Location-A} (for example General Storage), the bin New Inventory Part fills in, and bin {Bin-B} is a second bin at {Location-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BIN-B).
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-IVNET-POS-01) is active and tracked at {Location-A} at a cost of $10.00, with 5 in {Bin-A} and 3 in {Bin-B}.
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Reports and open the Inventory Value report.
  2. Leave the as-of date on today.
  3. Set the Location filter to {Location-A} only.
  4. Type the part number of {Part-A} in the report's Search box.
  5. Read the rows listed (Qty, Unit Cost and Total Cost).
  6. Read the Totals row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 5: {Part-A} is listed with Qty 8.00, Unit Cost $10.00 and Total Cost $80.00 (5 + 3 = 8; 8 × $10.00 = $80.00), the same result the report gave before this fix.
  • Step 6: Totals reads Qty 8.00 and Total Cost $80.00.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; bug SV-10380 (Inventory Value report ignores negative bins and overstates net inventory value; Ready to Fix, updated 9 Oct 2026; ships with this epic per Chris Ward's comments of 24 Sep and 7 Oct 2026), description, reproduction table and acceptance criteria, read 13 Oct 2026; PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), §2 Accounting, read 13 Oct 2026; QA lead's set-up answers of 9 Oct 2026 (situation 1: a bin below zero).
